Reviewer decision: cite an attributable dated tenant-strategy decision and redacted authoritative inventory reference; document the specific regulatory/business requirements that cannot be met in one tenant and the considered single-tenant alternatives.

Reviewer decision: independently substantiate tenant/ALZ boundaries, workload service/B2B support, collaboration, licensing, audit and JML implications. Neither subscription/resource counts nor Lighthouse registrations prove complete tenant inventory or strategy suitability.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Enforce a RBAC model that aligns to your cloud operating model. Scope and Assign across Management Groups and Subscriptions.
controls.rationale: Principal-type/role-definition configuration is not membership, evaluated permissions, inheritance or approved organizational responsibility. No directory/principal/role-definition expansion or permission change occurs.
evidence_requirements: Map complete direct/inherited management-group/subscription/resource grants, deny assignments, conditions and data actions to the approved operating model; supplied assignment subsets are not effective access.
Bind accountable central/workload responsibilities, approved role definitions and least-privilege scope to a redacted operating-model record with original-time evidence.
Reviewer decision: are actual grants aligned with that model, including exceptions, inherited/additive access, review/expiry and scope completeness?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Use managed identities instead of service principals for authentication to Azure services. You can check for existing service principals via Entra ID > Sign in Logs > Service principal logins.
controls.rationale: Identity type/count is partial configuration only. No principal/tenant ID, user-assigned identity ID, credential, token, service-principal inventory or sign-in-log read is retained or performed. This GUID is distinct from the MSA account-provenance B03.02.
evidence_requirements: Distinguish attached system/user-assigned identity configuration from actual application credential selection, downstream authorization and supported workload coverage.

Reconcile the intended workload population and attributable redacted authentication evidence. Managed identities are special service principals, so the mere existence of a service principal is not a failure.
Reviewer decision: do supported workloads actually use approved managed identities instead of managed application secrets, with lifecycle/authorization and unsupported cases documented?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Only use the authentication type Work or school account for all account types. Avoid using the Microsoft account (MSA) account type.
controls.rationale: No Azure resource flag can authenticate account origin. This remains a specific human-evidence workflow; no directory user records, account names, Graph lookup, login or identity conversion occurs. It never aliases the managed-identity B03.02 GUID.
evidence_requirements: Use an attributable redacted record to identify the actual authentication origin of accounts with Azure administrative rights, including guests/external identities and inherited access.
Do not infer work/school identity from email suffix, display name, directory userType=Member or a role assignment. Reconcile explicit emergency-access and approved external-account exceptions.
Reviewer decision: does the complete applicable account population use the approved work/school authentication origin, with individually documented exceptions and finite review validity?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Use Microsoft Entra groups to assign permissions. Add on-premises groups to the Entra ID only group if a group management system is already in place.
controls.rationale: No group creation, membership expansion, synchronization, directory role assignment or effective-permission computation occurs. User/principal names, IDs and condition text are withheld.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile complete group-based Azure assignments, actual transitive membership and exceptions to direct grants; Group principal type alone is insufficient.
Verify authoritative on-premises/cloud group management, synchronization/nesting constraints and role-assignable group requirements without assuming every nested or dynamic group is supported.
Reviewer decision: do approved groups and their managed memberships deliver the intended access, with ownership, periodic review and source-of-authority documented?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Enforce Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access policies for any user with rights to Azure environments.
controls.rationale: No Graph/directory/sign-in-log request, What If/evaluation trigger, policy creation/change or authentication action occurs. This is a source-specific human-evidence workflow, not a policy-presence pass.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile all applicable Azure users/roles/resources, policy conditions, included/excluded users/apps and emergency/service-account treatment against attributable original-time policy/evaluation records.
Distinguish enabled from report-only/disabled policies and actual grant/session logic; a policy's existence, one sign-in or a template does not establish universal enforcement.
Reviewer decision: is the intended Azure-access population actually governed by the approved Conditional Access controls, with coverage gaps and licensing/exception constraints explicit?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Enforce multi-factor authentication for any user with rights to the Azure environments.
controls.rationale: No user registration inventory, authentication method, biometric, phone, credential, sign-in record or challenge is collected or modified. A tenant default or self-reported registration cannot automatically pass this control.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile the complete Azure-access user population with the actual MFA requirement path, applicable authentication strength, exclusions/emergency procedures and original-time evaluation evidence.
Distinguish a registered method or isolated challenge from enforced MFA, and understand prior/satisfied authentication claims rather than assuming every compliant session prompts again.
Reviewer decision: is MFA enforced for the approved applicable population with attributable coverage, finite validity and explicitly reviewed gaps/exceptions?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Enforce centralized and delegated responsibilities to manage resources deployed inside the landing zone, based on role and security requirements.
controls.rationale: An assignment scope is not organizational agreement, readiness or operational ownership. No RBAC change, directory enumeration, owner impersonation or fabricated acceptance is performed.
evidence_requirements: Document accountable central/platform and workload responsibilities for security, access, resource changes, operations, incident escalation and review using an accepted responsibility matrix.
Reconcile actual delegated scopes and least-privilege grants with those responsibilities, inherited/deny/conditional access and managed exceptions.
Reviewer decision: have responsible humans explicitly accepted and operationalized the centralized/delegated model for the applicable landing-zone population?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Enforce Microsoft Entra ID Privileged Identity Management (PIM) to establish zero standing access and least privilege.
controls.rationale: No PIM grant/activation, Graph/directory/audit request, role change or privileged action is performed. Configuration or eligibility alone is not activation enforcement, and directory roles do not imply Azure-resource access.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile actual eligible, activated, permanent-active and time-bound assignments separately for Azure resource roles, Entra roles and relevant groups, including inherited access.

Verify least-privilege definitions, maximum activation duration, approval/MFA/justification, review/audit and attributable activation evidence; PIM presence does not establish zero standing privilege.

Reviewer decision: is standing privilege removed where intended, with explicitly justified emergency-access exceptions and accountable finite review rather than silently treating emergency permanent roles as compliant?

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Microsoft recommends that you use roles with the fewest permissions. Global Administrator is a highly privileged role that should be limited to emergency scenarios when you can't use an existing role.
controls.rationale: Directory configuration, effective authority, privilege need and actual emergency-only use remain human-evidenced. No Graph resource, directory read, role/group/PIM operation or inferred Entra privilege from Azure RBAC.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: reviewed current Entra-role guidance and precise directory questions only; Azure role assignments, role definitions, policy/query associations and managed identities cannot establish Entra directory authority or least privilege.

Reviewer decision: cite separately authorized redacted directory-role scope, active/eligible assignment and privilege review evidence against actual responsibilities and least-privileged built-in alternatives; no principal names or directory records.

Reviewer decision: justify every Global Administrator use that cannot be handled by another existing role, distinguishing normal administration from the separately governed permanent-active emergency access exception. No invented blanket custom-role policy.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: When deploying Active Directory Domain Controllers, use a location with Availability Zones and deploy at least two VMs across these zones. If not available, deploy in an Availability Set.
controls.rationale: No DC discovery, guest inspection, SKU/zone availability read, health/failover probe or automatic applicability. Missing/null/duplicate/wrong-type/foreign/denied/partial/stale evidence is not a pass. An empty explicit zone list means only nonzonal supplied configuration.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: explicit scoped VM zone/location and typed availability-set reference with known unique scoped set fault/update-domain counts. No inferred placement defaults or current regional availability.

Reviewer decision: independently identify the complete applicable AD DS controller population with redacted authorized evidence; VM names, tags, resource type, OS, extensions and location do not identify domain controllers.

Reviewer decision: demonstrate at least two actual controllers across different available zones, or a suitable availability set where zones are unavailable in that specific region, and substantiate operating health/replication independently. Supplied VM/set configuration is not complete inventory or resilience proof.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Deploy your Azure landing zone identity resources in multiple regions.  If using domain controllers, associate each region with an Active Directory site so that resources can resolve to their local domain controllers.
controls.rationale: Entra ID global services, regional AD DS, and managed Domain Services are different. VM/region/subnet labels and configured replicas prove neither DC roles nor site association, local resolution, replication health or regional recovery. No AD/guest/network probe or directory payload.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: supplied scoped VM locations and bounded explicit managed-domain replica subnet/location configurations. Resource metadata locations are not region availability or identity-resource designation; Terraform supplies only its initial replica subset.

Reviewer decision: identify applicable identity services, required workload/recovery regions and complete authorized service population, then reconcile actual multi-region service and workload placement with approved recovery requirements.

Reviewer decision: for self-managed AD DS, substantiate regional sites/subnets, replication and actual local DC locator/resolution/use with redacted dated references. Managed Domain Services replicas all share one AD site and do not support separate AD sites or replication settings; review its full-mesh connectivity and workload design separately.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Use Azure custom RBAC roles for the following key roles to provide fine-grain access across your ALZ: Azure platform owner, network management, security operations, subscription owner, application owner. Align these roles to teams and responsibilities within your business.
controls.rationale: Role type/scope count or joined definition existence proves neither least privilege, correct team alignment, effective access nor complete assignment population. Unsupported assignable scopes and generated/unbound Terraform role IDs remain explicit. No permissions changes or raw role actions.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: existing minimized assignment principal type/typed role definition plus explicit Azure role type and validated supported assignable-scope count, with unique known scoped joins only. No action content, principal IDs, role display names or descriptions.

Reviewer decision: reconcile approved platform/network/security/subscription/application responsibilities and separation of duties with actual effective Azure permissions, inheritance, conditions, eligibility, exclusions and independently attributable team ownership.

Reviewer decision: prefer adequate built-in roles and justify custom roles only where required by actual needs under current guidance, explicitly resolving the frozen checklist's blanket custom-role wording. An Azure role grants no Entra directory authority.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: If planning to switch from Active Directory Domain Services to Entra domain services, evaluate the compatibility of all workloads.
controls.rationale: Inherently manual workload compatibility and migration judgment remains manual. Neither service existence nor provider support is a tested compatibility outcome; no domain join, account, credential, trust, deployment or workload test is executed.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: reviewed capability and migration questions only; no runtime compatibility inference from domain resource, SKU, role, subnet or replica configuration.

Reviewer decision: independently inventory every applicable workload and its domain-join, LDAP bind/read/write, Kerberos/NTLM, Group Policy, schema/privilege and trust dependencies; cite redacted compatibility assessments and attributable actual test references.

Reviewer decision: reconcile the stand-alone managed-domain model, one-way identity synchronization, writes restricted for synchronized objects, external identities, trust/forest limitations and migration/rollback acceptance for all applicable workloads. Modern Entra-native applications and legacy domain dependencies differ.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: When using Microsoft Entra Domain Services, use replica sets. Replica sets will improve the resiliency of your managed domain and allow you to deploy to additional regions.
controls.rationale: No configured count, SKU, region label or subnet binding proves healthy replicas, supported current capacity, complete population or application recovery. Raw domain names, IPs, diagnostics, notifications, certificates and trust/password material are withheld. No new live route.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: RG-scoped Microsoft.AAD/domainServices explicit SKU and at most five embedded replicas, each with normalized configured location and typed unique subnet. Known scoped subnet/VNet joins are partial configuration context only.

Reviewer decision: reconcile the full replica population and actual supported regions/subscriptions, Enterprise/Premium requirement for multiple replicas, full-mesh VNet connectivity and required redundant regional workload placement.

Reviewer decision: substantiate actual replication/service health and geographical recovery separately. All managed replicas share one AD site. Terraform's initial_replica_set is explicitly a supplied subset; separately managed provider replicas are not invented ARM child resources or absence evidence.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Integrate Microsoft Entra ID logs with the platform-central Azure Monitor. Azure Monitor allows for a single source of truth around log and monitoring data in Azure, giving organizations a cloud native options to meet requirements around log collection and retention.
controls.rationale: Tenant diagnostics are unsupported within the existing assessment/collection boundary and remain an explicit human-evidence gap. No Graph/Entra/log read, query execution, raw sign-in/audit record, fabricated category or data-plane payload.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: current Entra integration/prerequisite questions and explicit tenant-plane limitation. Actual microsoft.aadiam/diagnosticSettings is tenant-only, unlike Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings; no subscription-scope synthetic directory diagnostic record or new tenant scope.

Reviewer decision: cite independently authorized, redacted directory AuditLogs/SignInLogs category routing and actual platform-central workspace ownership/destination configuration, with separate directory Security Administrator and workspace/data-access authorization.

Reviewer decision: demonstrate successful arriving tenant log coverage, time window, agreed retention, query/alert suitability and operating responsibilities with attributable references. Azure activity/resource diagnostics, a workspace or configured route alone cannot establish Entra ingestion or central integration.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Implement an emergency access or break-glass accounts to prevent tenant-wide account lockout. MFA will be turned on by default for all users in Oct 2024. We recommend updating these accounts to use passkey (FIDO2) or configure certificate-based authentication for MFA.
controls.rationale: Emergency account operations and strong-authentication suitability remain separate blank decisions, never Azure RBAC or configured-flag outcomes. No account creation, permission/PIM/MFA/CA/credential operation, login, validation drill or claim of current tenant rollout.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: current source-backed emergency operating and authentication questions only; the frozen October 2024 statement is historical, not universal current tenant enforcement.

Reviewer decision: separately substantiate the scoped emergency account operating model, at least two cloud-only accounts, permanent-active emergency GA exception, no federation dependency, authorized shared-versus-individual model, safe separate custody, secure workstations, use alerts, post-use review and at-least-90-day validation using redacted dated references.

Reviewer decision: separately substantiate phishing-resistant passkey/FIDO2 or appropriate certificate-based MFA, independent dependencies from normal admin methods and non-expiring/non-cleaned credentials/devices. Reconcile blocking/restricting Conditional Access exclusions separately from report-only policies and mandatory MFA; neither configuration nor an exception invents authentication success.

Reviewer decision: reconcile applicable enforcement phase and tenant rollout: phase 1 portals CRUD from October 2024, phase 2 gradually from October 1 2025 CLI/PowerShell/IaC/control-plane create/update/delete with read operations excluded; workload identities are unaffected. No account identifiers, method registrations, credential/passkey/certificate data or test sign-ins.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: When deploying Microsoft Entra Connect, use a staging sever for high availability/disaster recovery.
controls.rationale: Staging is not automatic active-active failover, Cloud Sync equivalence, actual recovery, password freshness or a health outcome. No commands, exports, account data, sign-ins, service changes or recovery drill are executed.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: current Connect Sync staging and recovery questions only. No directory, Connect scheduler, guest, password or synchronization transport; a VM or role cannot identify an active/staging server.

Reviewer decision: establish Connect Sync applicability separately from Cloud Sync or other architectures; cite redacted authorized evidence for the actual active/passive server population, maintained configuration parity, scheduler/recent synchronization, pending-export verification and accidental-deletion protection.

Reviewer decision: substantiate an approved and actually validated recovery procedure with attributable dated references, isolating the previous active server before promotion and allowing only one active exporter. Staging normally does not export or run password sync/writeback; review password backlog/catch-up, business downtime tolerances and recovery dependencies separately. Do not restart sync services during password catch-up.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Do not use on-premises synced accounts for Microsoft Entra ID role assignments, unless you have a scenario that specifically requires it.
controls.rationale: No Graph/directory read, principal payload, synchronization inference or fabricated exception. Resource role assignment configuration does not prove Entra role membership, cloud-native accounts, least privilege or an exception approval.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: current Entra guidance avoids on-premises synced accounts for Entra directory roles; Azure RBAC principalType, managed identities, VM names and resource roles cannot establish synchronization origin or directory privilege.

Reviewer decision: cite separately authorized, redacted evidence for complete applicable Entra role assignments, direct/group-mediated and active/eligible scope, cloud-native versus synced identity provenance, actual required authority and protection against on-premises compromise.

Reviewer decision: justify every specifically required synced-account exception independently, including business need, least-privileged alternatives, compensating controls, accountable approval and expiry/review references. The frozen checklist exception is not a current general recommendation to use synced administrators; an accepted exception is separate from the control outcome.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: When using Microsoft Entra ID Application Proxy to give remote users access to applications, manage it as a Platform resource.
controls.rationale: No App Proxy/connector/Graph transport, URL/principal/contact payload, registration, login, proxy configuration or live authentication test. Service capability and authored plans do not establish organization ownership or operational availability.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: the legacy Application Proxy link returns 404; use the current reviewed Entra application proxy overview and connector HA guidance. The cloud service and private network connectors are not synthetic ARM proxy resources.

Reviewer decision: establish actual remote web-application applicability and platform service ownership, separating central connector/security/update/monitoring/recovery responsibilities from workload onboarding, backend access, authentication/SSO and support responsibilities, with redacted approved references.

Reviewer decision: reconcile actual connector groups, at least two connectors per group (three preferred), independent outbound failure domains, automatic updates, backend session-persistence design and attributable operating/availability evidence. Connector names, VM counts or resource Owner cannot establish platform ownership or functioning access; proxy is not intended for routine internal-user traffic.

controls.applicability_note: Review recommendation conditions within selected scope.
controls.recommendation: Configure Identity network segmentation through the use of a virtual Network and peer back to the hub. Providing authentication inside application landing zone (legacy).
controls.rationale: No traffic, route, DNS, authentication or directory probe; no new live read or assumed reciprocal peering. Partial/stale/missing inventory cannot establish absence, complete topology, identity designation, segmentation or recovery.
evidence_requirements: Preparation: explicit per-direction peering access boolean and typed remote-VNet reference joined only to unique known supplied source/remote VNets inside the selected boundary. Missing, wrong-type, duplicate, denied, foreign, self-linked or unsupported joins remain explicit unknown; no name-based hub or identity designation.
